lessons: Phase 5.7 skipped: the English description was not changed. SKILL_HE.md gained frontmatter with a NEW Hebrew description, but the site-facing description comes from metadata.json display_description, which was untouched.

The v1.3.0 log records the hospitality regulation as having been 'corrected to תקנה 15א'. That is wrong: 15א is employee benefits and the files correctly say תקנה 16. The log was misleading the next cycle; corrected by not carrying it forward.
The v1.3.0 log recorded the VAT frequency threshold as 1,502,000, contradicting SKILL.md's 1,775,000. The SKILL.md figure is right. Dropped the wrong figure from the log so it cannot propagate.

Deferred: the CSV export assigns no VAT PERIOD column, which is the single most useful field for an accountant receiving a year's pile, and it depends on whether the business is on a cash or accrual basis.
Deferred: reverse charge and חשבונית עצמית are still one clause with no mechanism, no threshold and no worked example. Deferred since v1.3.0; must land next cycle.
Deferred: רשימון יבוא is named as a redirect with no field list and no handling in the script, though the script now routes foreign suppliers to it.

Deferred: אישור ניכוי מס במקור under section 164 for subcontractor payments, now deferred three cycles, against the most-populated category for the target user. Fix or move to Out of scope with a rationale.
Deferred: digital-scan rules under הוראות ניהול ספרים. The skill's own use case is a physical pile, so 'may I bin the paper' is a question it invites and never answers.

Deferred: the general Regulation 18(א) proportional rule and the taxable/exempt turnover split. The skill covers only the vehicle ladder, but 18(א) is drafted to cover the exempt-turnover case first and private use only as the residual.

UNVERIFIED, do not ship without a source: the VAT return due date for online filers (commonly given as the 19th) and for detailed-report filers (commonly given as the 23rd). The statute gives 15 days; the extensions could not be confirmed against an ITA source this cycle, so the skill says 'confirm the current date' rather than naming one.
UNVERIFIED: the NIS 309 small-value simplified-document figure for 2026. The base in the הוראות is 210 and the indexed figure could not be confirmed. Not added.
UNVERIFIED: whether the NIS 500,000 detailed-report threshold commenced on 1 January 2026. The figure is right; the commencement date was dropped rather than asserted.

Process lesson: four legacy evidence entries had raw_snippets that merely restated their own claim text, so --check-sources could never falsify them, and two of them cited URLs that are now 404. Self-referential snippets are the same defect class as a missing gate.

Process lesson, and the important one: this cycle REPEATED the v1.3.0 failure it had just written down. חשבונית עסקה was added to both language files as 'the trap in a pile of paperwork' and never added to the script's taxonomy, in the same commit that records the lesson about fixing things in prose only. Writing the lesson down is not the control. The control is: for every content fix, grep the script for the thing you just documented, and run it.
Process lesson: an unrecognised enum value defaulting to the most permissive branch is how the above became dangerous rather than merely incomplete. Fail closed on unknown document types.

Process lesson: a report can be internally inconsistent while every individual line is correct. The allocation flag and the net-deductible total were both right on their own terms and contradicted each other on the same page. Reconcile the totals against the flags, not just against each other.

Deferred: the general תקנה 18(א) taxable/exempt turnover split. The script returns a 100% deduction on every non-vehicle input, which is a WRONG number for a dealer with mixed turnover. It escapes being a defect today only because there is no field by which such a dealer could declare himself. If a taxable/exempt flag is ever added, this becomes a wrong-number bug immediately, so add the flag and the apportionment together or neither.

Deferred: עוסק פטור is not distinguished from עוסק מורשה by the script (the 9-digit number does not reveal it), so a substantive service invoice arriving with no VAT line raises no question about whether the supplier was entitled to issue a receipt.
Deferred: the hospitality keyword list blanket-blocks בית מלון and hotel, so genuine business-travel lodging is under-deducted. Conservative, disclosed in rule_applied, but wrong.
CARRY: the depreciation rates and the mixed-use mobile floor were REMOVED this cycle for want of a source. If the skill is to carry them again, read them off תקנות מס הכנסה (פחת) directly.

Process lesson, round three: the fix for a cosmetic-flag defect introduced two MORE cosmetic flags. Round two moved allocation-blocked VAT out of the deductible total and then added two new blocking checks that only printed. A per-case fix invites the next case; the general fix (a marker table every blocking flag registers in) is what actually closed it.

Process lesson: reusing a branch for a case it was not written for. חשבונית עסקה was routed through the 'no Israeli VAT arises' path built for foreign suppliers, which sets net equal to gross. The two cases look alike (deductible VAT is zero in both) and differ in whether VAT arises at all.

RESOLVED this cycle: keyword ordering was a deferred MINOR and turned out to produce a wrong VAT figure, because the Regulation 18 ladder keyed on the category code and 'ביטוח רכב' matched Insurance first. A mislabel that gates a computation is not a mislabel.

CARRY: the entity-prefix heuristic (51/52, 58) is still unsourced. The output was softened to say 'לפי הקידומת' rather than asserting a type. Source it against the Registrar of Companies next cycle or drop the classification.

Process lesson, round four: each round's fix introduced the next round's defect, three times running. Widening a keyword match created false positives; adding a blocking rule created a sign error; adding two flags created two cosmetic flags. Every one was caught only by RE-RUNNING the reviewer after fixing, never by the fix itself. Budget for the re-run, not just the fix.

Process lesson: substring matching on Hebrew is a trap worth a standing rule. רכב is inside רכבת and הרכבת, and the Latin side is no better (car / cartridge / cardboard). Match whole tokens unless the keyword is multi-word.

Process lesson: a signed quantity broke a rule written for unsigned ones. The blocking branch was correct for every positive deductible and inverted the meaning of a credit note. Check the sign before applying a 'set to zero' rule.
RESOLVED this cycle: the hotel over-block, previously deferred, was fixed because a business-travel לינה is not אירוח under תקנה 16 and the under-claim was a wrong number.
